items.title: Phil Flanigan interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: my dad has a very good jazz collection and hung out with Bird a few times

ctx.x: That was a long question, wasn’t it?

No, I got it. Basically I always liked bass — that sounds poetic, doesn’t it? Like every other thirteen year old in 1969, I took up the guitar, because I wanted to be another Pete Townshend or Jimi Hendrix. Well that didn’t last long luckily because my dad has a very good jazz collection and hung out with Bird a few times and that kind of a thing. So he has a comprehensive Charlie Parker collection, a very good collection of Lester Young and Benny Goodman and Basie and Ellington and on down the line. And I always…
Like a set of strings now, right?
